Container.Name: Hikidashi-Worker-CUDA
Container.Overview: Hikidashi-Worker with the CUDA libraries, for an NVIDIA card: larger Whisper models, about 50x realtime. Needs the Nvidia Driver plugin; set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to the GPU UUID it shows. Tagging and recipes call Ollama, which wants the GPU too.[br][br]Give it exactly the same Data path as Hikidashi. Use it instead of Hikidashi-Worker, not beside it.
Container.Requires: Hikidashi and Hikidashi-Server-Worker, on the same Data path.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Exactly Hikidashi's Data path. A pool, never /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Stages
Config.Description: Of asr, ocr, tag and recipe. asr,ocr when a GPU desktop tags for this box, or when there is no Ollama.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: The Ollama that tag and recipe call: Unraid's Ollama app on this server, with its port 11434 published, by default.

Config.Name: Profile
Config.Description: The models: cuda for the card.

Config.Name: Unload after
Config.Description: Seconds with no work before Whisper is unloaded.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: The card: its UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin, or all.

Config.Name: GPU capabilities
Config.Description: What the container may use of the card.
